response.sql: SELECT sites.riskeval, AVG(scans.gbsize / scans.spanmin) as average_file_size_per_minute FROM scans INNER JOIN sites ON scans.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry WHERE scans.chronotag >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND scans.chronotag <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY sites.riskeval ORDER BY sites.riskeval;
